tagline: A database client for six engines, in a browser tab.
description:
YourSQL connects to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, Google Cloud SQL and Greenplum, and gives each connection the tools you expect: browse databases and tables, read and edit rows, change structure, and run SQL.

Browsing is not a read-only grid. You can filter columns, sort, page through large tables, edit a row in a form, edit many rows in bulk, and export what you are looking at. Structure work — creating tables, adding and altering columns, indexes, charsets and collations — has its own UI, and anything the UI cannot do you can type into the SQL editor with syntax highlighting.

Several connections stay open in tabs at once, so moving between a staging and a production database is a click.
capabilities: MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, Google Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL) and Greenplum.
Several saved connections, open side by side in tabs.
Browse databases and tables with a sidebar tree.
Filter, sort, page and search table data.
Edit a row in a form, or edit many rows in bulk.
Create tables, add and alter columns, set types, charsets, collations and indexes.
SQL editor with syntax highlighting and result grids.
requirements: A reachable database server and credentials for it. YourSQL does not install one for you.
